fields.raw_predicate: Exact or minimally normalized verb/phrase used by the speaker.
fields.target_claim_id: Existing claim node when event targets a claim rather than an entity.
fields.object_entity_id: Optional third entity/object in ternary events.
fields.speaker_adoption: Whether current speaker adopts, rejects, merely reports, quotes, questions, or hypothesizes the proposition.
fields.explicitness: Whether event is explicit or inferred from context.
fields.polarity: Attitudinal polarity toward target; not truth status.
fields.relationship_evidence_state: Whether text merely asserts a relationship or independent evidence has documented it.
fields.fact_check_need: Whether proposition generated by event needs external verification.
fields.severity: Potential consequence if materially false/misleading; used only for review prioritization.
fields.related_claim_refs: Local claim IDs emitted in the same unit, e.g. C1/C2, which are deterministically mapped to stable claim IDs.
fields.related_claim_ids_json: Stable claim IDs written by the apply step after resolving related_claim_refs.
